# Fix draft attachments: replace cv.pdf with headshot_picture.png

gmail_pw = {a['account_name']: a['password'] for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()} 
access_token = apis.gmail.login(username='tra_wils@gmail.com', password=gmail_pw['gmail'])['access_token']
fs_token = apis.file_system.login(username='tra_wils@gmail.com', password=gmail_pw['file_system'])['access_token']

draft_id = 518
headshot_path = '/home/travis/documents/work/headshot_picture.png'

# Verify current draft state
cur_draft = apis.gmail.show_draft(access_token=access_token, draft_id=draft_id)
cur_attachments = cur_draft.get('attachments', [])
print('Current draft attachments:', [(a['id'], a['file_name']) for a in cur_attachments])

# Identify cv attachment(s)
cv_attachments = [a for a in cur_attachments if a.get('file_name','').lower().endswith('.pdf') and 'cv' in a.get('file_name','').lower()]
print('CV attachments found:', [(a['id'], a['file_name']) for a in cv_attachments])

# Remove CV attachment(s)
remove_results = []
for a in cv_attachments:
    r = apis.gmail.remove_attachment_from_draft(access_token=access_token, draft_id=draft_id, attachment_id=a['id'])
    remove_results.append((a['id'], a['file_name'], r))
print('Removed:', [(x[0], x[1]) for x in remove_results])

# Upload headshot
upload_r = apis.gmail.upload_attachments_to_draft(
    draft_id=draft_id,
    attachment_file_paths=[headshot_path],
    file_system_access_token=fs_token,
    access_token=access_token,
    overwrite=True
)
print('Upload response:', upload_r)

# Verify updated draft attachments
updated_draft = apis.gmail.show_draft(access_token=access_token, draft_id=draft_id)
upd_attachments = updated_draft.get('attachments', [])
print('Updated draft attachments:', [(a['id'], a['file_name']) for a in upd_attachments])

# Quick body snippet verification (no content dumping)
body = updated_draft.get('body','')
print('Body length:', len(body))
print('Body startswith:', body[:120].replace('\n','\\n'))
